additional_info.subject: ID0374303-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170000835] Converter issue CRM:00642001405
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing well.
We have received a case from an end customer regarding an issue with converters. Please follow the troubleshooting steps mentioned below:
1. Verify the converter grouping in the SCB; it should match the High Flex configuration.
2. Ensure that the power converter is properly connected to its shelf case.
3. Inspect for any loose connections in the power cables or CAN communication cables of the converter and measure the voltage across them using a multimeter. Also, check the resistance across the CAN communication cables.
4. Check the display of the power converter to determine if it is in the OFF or ON state.
Please find below attached KA link for your reference.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Power Converter_Missing converters - Dynamics 365
Please follow the steps outlined in the attached document and take note of the following points:
1. Inspect the areas highlighted in red for potential loose wiring.
2. If the wiring is secure and the configuration is correct, then replacement may not be necessary; however, ensure to check all connections of the KF14 module before deciding on its replacement. (Please refer to the KF14 module as KF13).
Also find below attached KA link for your reference.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SiCD_HW_KF13_ DC1_StateMonitor_KF13 error - Dynamics 365
